title: Nichelle Davis
description: Davis said in a news questionnaire that teachers and staff need “greater cultural awareness and sensitivity training.” She claimed exclusionary discipline “causes further harm” to students by “perpetuating the school to prison pipeline.”
body:
# Nichelle Davis

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/Davis_cropped.jpg)

- Davis said in a [news questionnaire](https://web.archive.org/web/20220325110842/https:/cobbcountycourier.com/2022/03/nichelle-davis-q-a-with-the-unopposed-candidate-for-cobb-school-board-post-6/) that teachers and staff need “greater cultural awareness and sensitivity training.” She claimed exclusionary discipline “causes further harm” to students by “perpetuating the school to prison pipeline.”
- Davis [opposed](https://web.archive.org/web/20220325110842/https:/cobbcountycourier.com/2022/03/nichelle-davis-q-a-with-the-unopposed-candidate-for-cobb-school-board-post-6/) state legislation prohibiting divisive concepts saying, “by censoring teachers’ ability to discuss these so-called ‘divisive concepts’ we are doing our students a great disservice.”
